fusions.name: Easing Wash
fusions.desc: A slow wash of water ahead of you that deals 4 damage to everything within 3 tiles in front of you, with a 40% chance per hit to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Nudge Along
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full range, and knocks it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Calm Waters
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Soft Hide
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 12, and you regenerate 1 health a second.
